name: acme_list_orders
title: List orders
description: Lists the orders of the store, newest first, with their status, total and customer. Filter by status or date.

name: acme_get_order
title: Get an order
description: Returns one order in full: lines, totals, addresses, payments, shipments and history.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order, from list_orders or search_orders

name: acme_search_orders
title: Search orders
description: Finds orders by reference, customer email or name.

name: acme_create_order
title: Create an order
description: Creates an order for a customer from a list of products, as staff do on the phone.

name: acme_cancel_order
title: Cancel an order
description: Cancels an order that has not shipped. Stock goes back and the customer is told.

name: acme_set_order_status
title: Change the status of an order
description: Sets the status of one order: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled. May email the customer.

name: acme_add_order_note
title: Add a note to an order
description: Adds a private staff note to an order. The customer does not see it.

name: acme_refund_payment
title: Refund a payment
description: Refunds all or part of the payment of an order to the customer's card.

name: acme_list_customers
title: List customers
description: Lists customer accounts, newest first.

name: acme_get_customer
title: Get a customer
description: Returns one customer account: contact details, addresses and order count.

name: acme_search_customers
title: Search customers
description: Finds customer accounts by email, name or phone.

name: acme_create_customer
title: Create a customer
description: Creates a customer account with a name and an email.

name: acme_update_customer
title: Update a customer
description: Changes the name, email or phone of a customer account.

name: acme_delete_customer
title: Delete a customer
description: Deletes a customer account. Their orders are kept.

name: acme_list_products
title: List products
description: Lists the products of the catalog with price and stock.

name: acme_get_product
title: Get a product
description: Returns one product in full: prices, variants, images, stock and description.

name: acme_search_products
title: Search products
description: Finds products by name, SKU or barcode.

name: acme_create_product
title: Create a product
description: Adds a product to the catalog with a name, a price and a stock.

name: acme_update_product
title: Update a product
description: Changes the name, price, description or images of a product.

name: acme_delete_product
title: Delete a product
description: Deletes a product from the catalog for good.

name: acme_set_product_visibility
title: Show or hide a product
description: Publishes a product on the storefront or hides it, without deleting it.

name: acme_get_inventory
title: Get inventory
description: Returns the stock level of a product in each warehouse.

name: acme_set_inventory_level
title: Set inventory level
description: Sets the quantity in stock of a product in a warehouse.

name: acme_list_low_inventory
title: List low inventory
description: Lists the products whose stock is below their alert threshold.

name: acme_list_coupons
title: List coupons
description: Lists discount coupons with their code, value and expiry.

name: acme_create_coupon
title: Create a coupon
description: Creates a discount coupon code, as a percentage or an amount.

name: acme_delete_coupon
title: Delete a coupon
description: Deletes a discount coupon. Orders that used it keep their discount.

name: acme_list_posts
title: List blog posts
description: Lists the posts of the blog with their status.

name: acme_get_post
title: Get a blog post
description: Returns one blog post with its content.

name: acme_create_post
title: Create a blog post
description: Writes a new blog post as a draft.

name: acme_update_post
title: Update a blog post
description: Changes the title or content of a blog post.

name: acme_publish_post
title: Publish a blog post
description: Publishes a draft post on the blog.

name: acme_delete_post
title: Delete a blog post
description: Deletes a blog post.

name: acme_list_comments
title: List comments
description: Lists the comments left on blog posts, newest first.

name: acme_delete_comment
title: Delete a comment
description: Deletes a comment from a blog post, for spam or abuse.

name: acme_get_sales_report
title: Get the sales report
description: Returns revenue, order count and average basket over a period.

name: acme_list_top_products
title: List best-selling products
description: Lists the products that sold the most over a period.

name: acme_list_shipping_methods
title: List shipping methods
description: Lists the carriers and shipping methods offered at checkout, with their price.

name: acme_create_shipment
title: Create a shipment
description: Creates a shipment for an order and books the carrier.

name: acme_get_shipment_tracking
title: Get shipment tracking
description: Returns the tracking number and delivery progress of a shipment.

name: acme_list_users
title: List staff users
description: Lists the staff accounts of the back office with their role.

name: acme_invite_user
title: Invite a staff user
description: Sends an invitation to a new staff member with a role.

name: acme_set_user_role
title: Change a staff role
description: Changes the role and permissions of a staff account.

name: acme_clear_cache
title: Clear the cache
description: Empties the cache of the store so changes show at once.

name: acme_get_settings
title: Get store settings
description: Returns the store name, currency, languages and time zone.

name: acme_update_settings
title: Update store settings
description: Changes the store name, currency, languages or time zone.

name: acme_list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
description: Lists the webhooks the store calls on events.

name: acme_create_webhook
title: Create a webhook
description: Registers an address the store calls when an event happens.

name: acme_delete_webhook
title: Delete a webhook
description: Removes a webhook.

name: acme_send_newsletter
title: Send a newsletter
description: Sends an email campaign to the subscribers.
